editorial:
You meet Roger Brown, a smooth-talking headhunter who secretly steals expensive art to keep up his flashy lifestyle and impress his wife. When he targets a rare painting owned by Clas Greve, a dangerous former mercenary, what looks like an easy score turns into a deadly chase across Norway. The movie mixes sharp humor with tense action, and you feel every close call as Roger scrambles to survive. It is stylish, fast, and full of surprises that keep you guessing.

The acting is strong, especially the lead, and the pacing rarely slows down once the trouble starts. Some twists feel a bit wild, and the violence can be intense, but the story stays fun and easy to follow. If you like clever thrillers with dark humor, this is a great pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Roger realizes Clas has been tracking him and uses that against him. After a brutal showdown, Roger kills Clas and escapes the trap. He survives the ordeal, clears his name enough to move forward, and returns to his wife, finally dropping the lies that put him in danger. The last twist shows Roger is not as powerless as he seemed, and his quick thinking saves him.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves clever crime thrillers with dark humor and high stakes.
